class.name: JRPGAutotileResolver
class.brief_description: Works out which shape every autotile cell of a map layer shows.
class.description: A map layer stores one palette index per cell (0 for an empty cell); for an autotile or wall kind the cell stores only the kind, and the resolver works out its shape from the cells around it. A neighbor counts when it holds the same palette index on the same layer. Outside the map, a looping axis wraps around to the other side; otherwise [constant EDGE_BORDER] decides: without it the kind runs on past the edge, with it the kind ends there. Blob kinds use all eight neighbors ([method JRPGAutotile.get_blob_index]), wall kinds the four sides ([method JRPGAutotile.get_wall_mask]). Shapes are never stored with the map: they are resolved when a map loads, and [method update_around] resolves the cells around each edit again. The resolver works on palette indexes only, without a [TileSet] or nodes, so the editor, the game and servers share it.

method.name: get_flags
method.description: Returns the [enum Flags] for a map whose horizontal and vertical axes loop as given ([param loop_horizontal], [param loop_vertical]), drawn with a tileset whose [member JRPGTilesetData.edge_mode] is [param edge_mode].

method.name: get_neighbor_mask
method.description: Returns the neighbor mask of [param cell] for its own palette index (8 bits in the [enum JRPGAutotile.Neighbor] order, before corner reduction). [param cells] holds [param size] cells row by row; [param flags] combines [enum Flags] values.

method.name: get_palette_kinds
method.description: Returns the [enum Kind] of every palette index of a [member JRPGTilesetData.palette], index 0 (the empty cell) included.

method.name: resolve_cell
method.description: Returns the shape of [param cell]: 0 to 46 for a blob kind, 0 to 15 for a wall kind, or [code]-1[/code] for a plain tile, an empty cell or an index [param kinds] does not have.

method.name: resolve_layer
method.description: Returns the shape of every cell of a layer, one byte per cell in the order of [param cells]. Cells without a shape hold 0.

method.name: update_around
method.description: After cell [param cell] of a layer changed, resolves its 3 x 3 neighborhood again (across the edge of a looping map). [param shapes] is the layer's [method resolve_layer] result before the edit. Returns a dictionary with [code skip-lint]shapes[/code], the updated shapes, and [code]changed[/code], the cells whose shape changed (the edited cell is always listed).

constants.constant: A plain tile, the empty cell or an unknown palette index: it has no shape.
A blob autotile kind (47 shapes from eight neighbors).
A wall autotile kind (16 shapes from four sides).
The map loops horizontally: the left and right edges are neighbors.
The map loops vertically: the top and bottom edges are neighbors.
Outside the map counts as another kind, so autotiles draw their edge at the map border. Without it, outside the map counts as the same kind ([member JRPGTilesetData.edge_mode]).
